observations: 4-burner gas cooker with a black enamel top and a wooden handle.
The control panel features four knobs and a central ignition button.
The unit is wrapped in clear plastic, suggesting it is new or recently refurbished.
A watermark 'HITECH TECHNOLOGY' is visible across the center of the image.
The background shows a car and a concrete floor, suggesting an outdoor or workshop setting.

claims.evidence: The unit is wrapped in plastic, which is common for new items, but the condition of the burners and knobs cannot be confirmed.
No video or photo of the burners lit or the knobs operating.

risks.risk: Burners may be clogged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing all four burners lit simultaneously.

risks.risk: Knobs or ignition may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing each knob being turned and the corresponding burner igniting.

risks.risk: The unit may be a generic or low-quality brand rather than a premium one.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's rating plate (usually on the back or side).

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of all four burners lit and the knobs being operated.
Photo of the manufacturer's rating plate showing the brand and model number.
Photo of the underside of the cooker to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
